query:
WITH stage_tasks AS (
    SELECT
        stk.id AS step_task_id,
        ss.id AS stage_step_id,
        pstage.id AS playbook_stage_id
    FROM rev.playbook_stages pstage
    JOIN rev.stage_steps ss ON ss.stage_id = pstage.stage_id
    JOIN rev.step_tasks stk ON stk.step_id = ss.step_id
    WHERE pstage.id = $1
),
all_overlays AS (
        SELECT
        st.step_task_id,
        op.id,
        vspd.name,
        vk.id AS value_kind_id,
        vk.key AS value_kind_key,
        o.visibility,
        1 AS priority
    FROM rev.playbook_stage_overlays o
    JOIN stage_tasks st ON st.playbook_stage_id = o.playbook_stage_id
    JOIN rev.object_paths op ON op.id = o.value_slot_path_id
    JOIN rev.value_slot_path_details vspd ON vspd.path_id = op.id
    JOIN rev.value_kinds vk ON vk.id = vspd.value_kind_id

    UNION ALL

        SELECT
        st.step_task_id,
        op.id,
        vspd.name,
        vk.id AS value_kind_id,
        vk.key AS value_kind_key,
        o.visibility,
        2 AS priority
    FROM rev.stage_step_overlays o
    JOIN stage_tasks st ON st.stage_step_id = o.stage_step_id
    JOIN rev.object_paths op ON op.id = o.value_slot_path_id
    JOIN rev.value_slot_path_details vspd ON vspd.path_id = op.id
    JOIN rev.value_kinds vk ON vk.id = vspd.value_kind_id

    UNION ALL

        SELECT
        st.step_task_id,
        op.id,
        vspd.name,
        vk.id AS value_kind_id,
        vk.key AS value_kind_key,
        o.visibility,
        3 AS priority
    FROM rev.step_task_overlays o
    JOIN stage_tasks st ON st.step_task_id = o.step_task_id
    JOIN rev.object_paths op ON op.id = o.value_slot_path_id
    JOIN rev.value_slot_path_details vspd ON vspd.path_id = op.id
    JOIN rev.value_kinds vk ON vk.id = vspd.value_kind_id
),
ranked AS (
        SELECT DISTINCT ON (step_task_id, id)
        step_task_id,
        id,
        name,
        value_kind_id,
        value_kind_key,
        visibility
    FROM all_overlays
    ORDER BY step_task_id, id, priority DESC
)
SELECT DISTINCT
    id,
    name,
    value_kind_id,
    value_kind_key
FROM ranked
WHERE visibility = 'expose'
ORDER BY name;
